subject: science
grouping_policy: Rule: independent subquestions (問) are separate requests; 問 sharing conditions, passages, figures or a continuing story stay together; the sub-items (1, 2, ...) inside one 問 are never split. Pages used whole when only one unit is on them. Groups defined from the problem pages only, without answer-key content.

notices_excluded.reason: Scoring notice (一部設問の取り扱い): 大問6 問1 2 declared 不成立 with points given to all examinees. Scoring measure, not a problem-condition change; not sent to the model. The subquestion itself stays in the 大問6 unit starting at 問1.

answer_format: Mark sheet. Most items: choose one of the katakana choices (ア-エ ... ア-コ) per 問 or per numbered sub-item; some items ask for two answers 'それぞれ選べ' (e.g. 大問1 問5 for 反応A/B, 問6 ①/②, 大問2 問3 ①/②, 問4 直列/並列, 大問5 問2 2 震源G/時間). Combination tables (ア-キ, ア-ク) for multi-blank items. Numeric answers use digit boxes labeled in katakana: 'ア.イ cm3' (大問3 問2 3,4), 'ア.イ %' (大問6 問2), 'アイウ m' (大問6 問4 1), 'アイ °' (大問6 問4 3). Cover instructions 9-11 explain digit boxes, rounding to the given form, and one choice per answer field.
